proposal.label: Background Database
proposal.definition: Source representing a background LCI database used for the LCA modelling (e.g. ecoinvent, GaBi/Sphera, Okobaudat).
proposal.rationale: Captures the LCI database referenced in LCA calculations, a concept not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: Compliance System
proposal.definition: A standard or programme against which an LCA or EPD study is declared compliant, such as ISO 14040/14044, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR programmes, or a specific programme operator's scheme.
proposal.rationale: This class captures the concept of a compliance system for LCA/EPD studies, which is not covered by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: EN 15804 Inventory Indicator
proposal.definition: An EN 15804+A2 inventory‑level indicator (resource use, waste disposed, or output flow for valorisation/exported energy). The value is an aggregated inventory quantity; results are represented by eudpp:InventoryIndicatorResult instances.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific inventory‑level indicator defined in EN 15804+A2, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Energy Consumption Result
proposal.definition: An LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the consumption of primary energy resources—renewable and non‑renewable—in a product system, typically expressed as EN 15804+A2 primary energy indicators such as PERE, PERM, PERT, PENRE, PENRM or PENRT.
proposal.rationale: This class captures the specific LCA result for primary energy consumption, which is not represented by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Impact Model
proposal.definition: The characterisation model underlying an LCIA method (e.g. IPCC AR6 2021 for GWP). It carries a model name, optional version and optional bibliographic source.
proposal.rationale: Captures the LCIA characterisation model used in LCA studies, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: LCA Indicator
proposal.definition: Abstract umbrella class for an indicator definition (impact or inventory category) that a method calculates values for. Each instance identifies exactly one method under which it is computed.
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic definition of an LCA indicator, distinct from result instances and not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: LCA Method
proposal.definition: A life‑cycle assessment method that produces values for one indicator from an inventory of elementary flows, covering both characterised LCIA methods and inventory aggregation methods such as EN 15804+A2 inventory indicators.
proposal.rationale: Defines the generic method used to calculate an LCA indicator, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: LCA Methodology
proposal.definition: A named, versioned LCA methodology—a coherent set of LCA methods sharing principles and a common set of characterisation factors. Individual Method instances belong to one or more LCAMethodology instances.
proposal.rationale: Captures the overarching methodology that groups related LCIA methods, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: LCA Study
proposal.definition: A life‑cycle assessment study of a product, conducted per ISO 14040/14044, producing one or more LCA results. It contains study‑level metadata such as UUID, dataset version, name, reference year, license, copyright, ILCD format version, compliance declarations, manufacturer records, reviews and references to data sources or background databases.
proposal.rationale: Provides a container for an LCA study, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: LCIA Method Report
proposal.definition: Source that documents a life‑cycle impact assessment (LCIA) method, such as the EF 3.1 method description.
proposal.rationale: Captures the documentation of an LCIA method, a concept not represented by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: License Type
proposal.definition: Closed enumeration of licence categories that govern access to and use of an LCA or EPD study.
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated class for the licence categories applicable to LCA/EPD studies, not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: SoC Qualification Assertion
proposal.definition: A documented, explicit assertion that a substance satisfies one or more non‑exclusive qualification criteria in ESPR Article 2(27). For criterion (d) the applicable product context is represented by a dpp:SubstancePresence linked through dpp:hasApplicableQualification.
proposal.rationale: Captures the evidence‑based assertion of ESPR qualification, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Substance Management Instruction
proposal.definition: Instruction concerning the management of a substance of concern within its SubstancePresence context, covering safe use, disassembly, preparation for reuse, recycling and environmentally sound end‑of‑life handling.
proposal.rationale: Captures the ESPR Article 7(5)(d‑e) guidance on substance handling, a concept not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Substance Presence
proposal.definition: Contextual relation entity representing the presence of a substance in a product, component or spare part as placed on the market. It allows location‑specific concentration and instruction data to be attached without treating those attributes as intrinsic properties of the substance itself.
proposal.rationale: Provides the modelling abstraction required by ESPR Article 7(5) to capture product‑dependent substance information, a concept not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: Sustainable Renewable Materials Use Result
proposal.definition: LCA inventory indicator result quantifying the use of renewable secondary material and fuel inputs in a product system, typically aligned with EN 15804+A2 indicators such as Use of Renewable Secondary Fuels (RSF).
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated result class for renewable material use, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Type of Review
proposal.definition: Enumeration of the kind of critical review or verification performed on a dataset, matching ILCD TypeOfReviewValues.
proposal.rationale: Captures the review type dimension required for LCA datasets, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Access Restrictions
proposal.definition: Human‑readable description of the access and use restrictions for an LCA or EPD study, equivalent to dcterms:accessRights.
proposal.rationale: Provides the textual access‑rights annotation required for LCA studies, not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: Addresses Area of Protection
proposal.definition: Links an LCIA impact category to the one or more Areas of Protection it addresses, e.g. ozone depletion affecting both Natural Environment and Human Health.
proposal.rationale: Captures the mapping between impact categories and protection areas required by LCA methodology, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Assesses Impact Category
proposal.definition: Links an LCIA impact indicator to the mid‑point impact category it characterises, allowing multiple indicators to refer to the same category.
proposal.rationale: Provides the conceptual classification link between indicators and categories required by LCA methodology, not covered by existing terms.

proposal.label: Belongs to EN 15804 Indicator Group
proposal.definition: Links an EN 15804 indicator individual to the indicator group it belongs to (core impact, with‑caveats, resource use, waste, valorisation, exported energy).
proposal.rationale: Provides the grouping relationship required for EN 15804 indicators, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Belongs to Methodology
proposal.definition: Links an LCAMethod to one or more LCAMethodology individuals it belongs to (e.g. eudpp:methodology_EF3_1). A single method may be classified under multiple methodologies when they share the same characterisation factors for an indicator.
proposal.rationale: Captures the many‑to‑many relationship between methods and methodologies required for LCA, not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: CAS Name
proposal.definition: The Chemical Abstracts Service name of the substance, when available.
proposal.rationale: Provides the human‑readable CAS name for a substance, complementing the numeric CAS number already captured.

proposal.label: Computed by Method
proposal.definition: Links an LCAIndicator individual to the LCAMethod instance that describes how the indicator is calculated, including its impact model, category, methodology reference and ILCD metadata.
proposal.rationale: Captures the single method that defines an indicator’s computation, a relationship not represented by existing terms.

proposal.label: Concerns Substance
proposal.definition: Links a reported SubstancePresence to the specific SubstanceOfConcern that is present, restricting the relation to substances identified as concerns rather than generic substances.
proposal.rationale: Captures the SOC‑specific link between a presence record and a substance of concern, which is not covered by existing generic substance relations.

proposal.label: Data Set Version
proposal.definition: Version number of this LCA/EPD study instance, independent of the ontology version. Format: major.minor.sub-minor (e.g., "02.00.011").
proposal.rationale: Captures the version of an LCA study instance, a concept not represented by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Declares Manufacturer Record
proposal.definition: Links an LCA study to a manufacturer record documenting the manufacturers whose data is included in the study.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a study and the manufacturer(s) whose data contributed, using OperatorInformation as the closest existing class.
proposal.caveat: A dedicated ManufacturerRecord class could be introduced for clarity; currently reusing OperatorInformation.

proposal.label: ECHA Number
proposal.definition: Number assigned to a substance by the European Chemicals Agency, when available and appropriate.
proposal.rationale: Captures the ECHA identifier for a chemical substance, a concept not represented by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: EPD Format Version
proposal.definition: Version tag of the ILCD+EPD format used (e.g., "1.3").
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific ILCD+EPD format version for an EPD study, a concept not represented by any existing term in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: For Scenario
proposal.definition: Identifier of the scenario this LCIA module value applies to (free‑text label matching the EPD’s scenario declaration).
proposal.rationale: Captures the scenario context for an LCIA module value, which is not represented by any existing class in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Has Applicable Qualification
proposal.definition: Links a SubstancePresence to an applicable SoC qualification assertion; the criterion applies in a presence‑scoped context.
proposal.rationale: Captures the relationship between a substance presence record and the SoC qualification that applies to it.

proposal.label: Has Compliance Declaration
proposal.definition: Link from an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to a compliance declaration that asserts conformity with any relevant standard (e.g., ISO 14040/44, ISO 14025, ISO 14067, ISO 21930, EN 15804+A2, PEFCR rules).
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic link from an LCA study to the declaration of compliance with applicable environmental standards, which is not yet represented by a dedicated term in our vocabulary.
proposal.caveat: The range uses oec:ComplianceSystem as a placeholder; a dedicated ComplianceDeclaration class may be introduced in future revisions.

proposal.label: Has Copyright
proposal.definition: Indicates whether a copyright applies to the LCA or EPD study (true if applicable, false otherwise).
proposal.rationale: Provides a simple flag to record the presence of copyright on an LCA/EPD study.

proposal.label: Has External Source
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy to a background source such as a project report, safety data sheet, database or literature reference used for modelling.
proposal.rationale: Provides a generic reference to any external material that underpins the LCA study.

proposal.label: Has Impact Model
proposal.definition: Links an LCAMethod to its characterisation‑model block, if one exists; inventory‑only methods may not have a model.
proposal.rationale: Captures the optional link from a method to the impact model that defines its characterisation.

proposal.label: Has Inventory Indicator Result
proposal.definition: Sub‑property of hasLCAResult that links an LCAStudy to a specific inventory indicator result (e.g., EN 15804 inventory indicator).
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated link for inventory‑level results within an LCA study, which is not yet represented by a separate property in our vocabulary.
proposal.caveat: The range uses oec:EN15804InventoryIndicator as a placeholder; a dedicated InventoryIndicatorResult class may be introduced in future revisions.

proposal.label: Has LCA Result
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy (or its subclass EPDStudy) to one of its LCA results, covering both inventory‑level and LCIA results.
proposal.rationale: Provides a single property that aggregates all LCA result types for querying convenience.

proposal.label: Has LCA Verifier
proposal.definition: Links a Review to the independent actor that performed or is responsible for verifying an LCA study or EPD.
proposal.rationale: Provides a direct reference from a review to the verifier actor, covering internal or third‑party verification.

proposal.label: Has LCIA Result
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy to a specific LCIAResult, the quantified impact category outcome of the life‑cycle assessment.
proposal.rationale: Provides a typed link from a study to its LCIA results, distinct from inventory‑only results.

proposal.label: Has License Type
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy to the license that authorises its conduct or publication, such as a national or sectoral LCA/EPD licence.
proposal.rationale: Captures the regulatory licence required for an LCA/EPD study, distinct from the EPD reference standard.

proposal.label: Has Manufacturing Site
proposal.definition: Links a ManufacturerRecord to the Facility where the product is produced, as required by ILCD+EPD v1.3.
proposal.rationale: Captures the manufacturing location for a product, tying the record to its physical site.

proposal.label: Has Next DPP
proposal.definition: Links a Digital Product Passport to its successor passport, indicating the next version in the product’s lifecycle.
proposal.rationale: Provides a direct reference to the next DPP instance, supporting versioning and traceability.

proposal.label: Has Preparation‑for‑Reuse Instruction
proposal.definition: Links a SubstancePresence to the SubstanceManagementInstruction that contains guidance on how to prepare the substance for reuse.
proposal.rationale: Provides a typed link from the presence of a substance to reuse‑preparation guidance, distinct from safe‑use instructions.

proposal.label: Has Qualification Assertion
proposal.definition: Links a SubstanceOfConcern to the SoCQualificationAssertion that documents its compliance status or assessment.
proposal.rationale: Provides a typed link from the identified substance to its documented qualification, distinct from threshold or presence.

proposal.label: Has Reference To Background Database
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy to one or more BackgroundDatabase instances that supplied the life‑cycle inventory data used in the study.
proposal.rationale: Captures the source databases for LCI data, a required link in an LCA study.

proposal.label: Has Review
proposal.definition: Links an LCAStudy to a critical‑review or verification record that assessed the study’s methodology and data.
proposal.rationale: Captures the external review that validates an LCA study, a required audit step.

proposal.label: Has SoC Criterion
proposal.definition: Links a Substance of Concern Qualification Assertion to one or more criteria that define the level of concern (e.g., A, B, C, D).
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific SoC classification criteria attached to a qualification assertion.

proposal.label: Has Substance Presence
proposal.definition: Links a product to the SubstancePresence instances that describe where and how a substance is present within the product.
proposal.rationale: Captures the contextual presence of substances in a product, tying the product to its substance‑presence records.

proposal.label: Has Type Of Review
proposal.definition: Links a review record to the TypeOfReview that describes whether it is independent, accredited third‑party, or another review category.
proposal.rationale: Captures the nature of the review performed on an LCA study.

proposal.label: Identifies Data Provider
proposal.definition: Links a manufacturer record to the Actor that supplied or submitted the inventory data for the record, which may differ from the product’s manufacturer.
proposal.rationale: Captures the entity responsible for providing the data used in a manufacturer record.

proposal.label: Identifies Manufacturer
proposal.definition: Links a manufacturer record to the Actor that represents the economic operator or company whose production process and product are described by the record.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific manufacturer responsible for a product’s production as recorded in a manufacturer record.

proposal.label: ILCD Format Version
proposal.definition: Specifies the ILCD schema version used to serialise this LCA study (e.g., '1.1').
proposal.rationale: Captures the ILCD version of an LCA study, distinct from the DPP schema version.

proposal.label: International Name
proposal.definition: An internationally recognised name for the substance used when an IUPAC name is not available.
proposal.rationale: Provides a fallback name for substances when the systematic IUPAC name is unavailable, complementing oec:iupacName.

proposal.label: Is Declared
proposal.definition: True if the module value is declared in the study (has a numerical amount), false if explicitly marked as not declared (ND/MND). Absence of the triple means the module was not in scope.
proposal.rationale: Captures the declared status of an LCAModuleValue within a study.

proposal.label: Is Substance Presence Of
proposal.definition: Inverse relation from a SubstancePresence instance to the Product that contains it.
proposal.rationale: Captures the product that a given substance presence refers to, complementing oec:substanceLocation.

proposal.label: Material Type Scheme
proposal.definition: Reference system that defines the material type, such as ISO 11224 or EU Textile Regulation 1007/2011 Annex I.
proposal.rationale: Captures the external scheme used to classify a material type, which is not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Maximum Numerical Value
proposal.definition: The upper bound of a concentration range expressed as a decimal.
proposal.rationale: Captures the numeric upper limit of a concentration range for substances.

proposal.label: Method Version
proposal.definition: Version of the specific LCIA or inventory method instance, distinct from the methodology-level version.
proposal.rationale: Captures instance‑level versioning for an LCAMethod, a concept not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Methodology Version
proposal.definition: Version identifier of an LCAMethodology individual (e.g., "3.1" for EF 3.1, "2002" for CML 2002).
proposal.rationale: Captures the version of an LCAMethodology, a concept not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Minimum Numerical Value
proposal.definition: The lower bound of a concentration range.
proposal.rationale: Provides the numeric lower limit for a concentration range, complementing maximumNumericalValue.

proposal.label: Model Version
proposal.definition: Version of the characterisation model used (e.g., "IPCC AR6 2021" vs. "IPCC AR5 2013", which yield different GWP100 values).
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific version of an ImpactModel, a concept not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Provides LCA Data
proposal.definition: Indicates whether the manufacturer in this record supplied primary LCA data for the study.
proposal.rationale: Captures the data‑source status of a ManufacturerRecord for LCA studies.

proposal.label: Qualification Note
proposal.definition: Additional explanation or limitation of a SoC qualification assertion.
proposal.rationale: Captures free‑text commentary attached to a SoCQualificationAssertion.

proposal.label: Qualification Valid From
proposal.definition: First date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid.
proposal.rationale: Captures the start date of validity for a SoCQualificationAssertion.

proposal.label: Qualification Valid Until
proposal.definition: Last date on which the qualification assertion is considered valid, when bounded.
proposal.rationale: Captures the end date of validity for a SoCQualificationAssertion.

proposal.label: Qualifies Substance
proposal.definition: Links a SoC qualification assertion to the substance of concern that it positively qualifies.
proposal.rationale: Captures the specific substance of concern that a SoC qualification assertion applies to.

proposal.label: Reference to Complete Review Report
proposal.definition: Link from a Review to the full review report.
proposal.rationale: Provides a reference to the complete review report associated with a Review.

proposal.label: Reference To Compliance Status
proposal.definition: Link from a ComplianceDeclaration to the compliance status it declares (fully, partially or not compliant).
proposal.rationale: Provides a dedicated link between a compliance declaration and the ComplianceStatus value, which is not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Reference to Compliance System
proposal.definition: Link from a ComplianceDeclaration to the standard or programme it references (e.g., EN 15804+A2, ISO 14025, ISO 21930).
proposal.rationale: Connects a ComplianceDeclaration to the compliance system it cites.

proposal.label: Reference to External Source
proposal.definition: Link from an LCAMethod to the external documentation that describes the method.
proposal.rationale: Connects a method to the external source that provides its detailed description.

proposal.label: Reference to LCA Method Report
proposal.definition: Link from an LCAMethod to the formal LCIA method report that describes it (e.g., EF 3.1).
proposal.rationale: Connects a method to the authoritative LCIA method report that underpins it.

proposal.label: Reference to Model Source
proposal.definition: Link from an ImpactModel to the bibliographic source(s) that describe its characterisation model.
proposal.rationale: Connects a model to the literature or documentation that defines it.

proposal.label: Reference to Original EPD
proposal.definition: Link from an EPDStudy to the published EPD document (typically a PDF).
proposal.rationale: Connects a study to the original EPD document that it represents.

proposal.label: Reference Year
proposal.definition: Start year of the time period for which an LCAStudy is valid.
proposal.rationale: Captures the year that defines the temporal scope of an LCA study, a concept not yet represented by an existing property in our vocabulary.

proposal.label: Relates to LCA Indicator
proposal.definition: Links an EN15804 impact indicator to the conceptually corresponding EF 3.1 / PEF LCIA impact indicator, recording a conceptual correspondence without implying equivalence.
proposal.rationale: Captures the conceptual mapping between an EN15804 indicator and its broader LCIA counterpart.

proposal.label: Review Date
proposal.definition: Date on which the review was completed, allowing DPP consumers to assess currency of the review.
proposal.rationale: Captures the completion date of a review activity within an LCA context.

proposal.label: Source Vocabulary
proposal.definition: Provenance annotation identifying the vocabulary, standard or ontology from which a class, property or individual of this ontology aligns.
proposal.rationale: Captures the external source of alignment for any term in the LCA module.

proposal.label: UUID
proposal.definition: Universally Unique Identifier of an LCA/EPD study, generated once and unchanged; increments eudpp:dataSetVersion on updates.
proposal.rationale: Provides the persistent identifier required by ILCD+EPD for each study.
